programme.title: Ambush In Leopard Street
programme.desc: 1962. Crime Thriller. Stars James Kenney & Bruce Seton. A retired thief forms a gang for one last job, a diamond shipment. With good locations and a British cast it's an enjoyable British B film. [S]

programme.title: The Rogues
programme.desc: 1965. The Computer Goes West. Gig Young, David Niven and Charles Boyer are The Rogues, members of two related families of international forgers and conmen. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Sheriff's Boots. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Rufus Cruickshank. The Sheriff of Nottingham needs new boots. A village has a new secret to leather making and he wants it. [S]

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Dead Man's Rock. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Richard Pasco & Edwin Richfield. Spaniards attack while the Sultana is beached, and Governor Beamish is kidnapped. Tempest must find a way to rescue him. [S]

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Young Widow. 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Having escaped from Gessler's troops, Tell and his wife are given refuge by the beautiful Countess von Marheim. [S]

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: One Just Man. 1954. Stars Joan Haythorne & Alexander Knox. Judge Craig had always been ruthless to the criminals he sentenced but when dealing with his own family will he be as unrelenting? [S]

programme.title: Return of a Stranger (1937)
programme.desc: 1937. Crime. Directed by Victor Hanbury. James & Carol have plans to elope, but a fight with her father's solicitor ends in murder. Stars Griffith Jones, Rosalyn Boulter and James Harcourt. [S]

programme.title: Glencannon: The Loving Cup
programme.desc: 1959. Comedy. Stars Thomas Mitchell & Patrick Allen. A wonderful episode of the rare series about the adventures of Colin Glencannon, the chief engineer of the freighter Inchcliffe Castle. [S]

programme.title: Take a Letter Mr Jones
programme.desc: The Interview. 1981. Starring John Inman & Rula Lenska. Joan is about to do an interview with a reporter about being a successful woman in business and she is becoming concerned. [S]

programme.title: Park Ranger
programme.desc: 1978. New Boy. Featuring Norman Bowler as a trainee warden in a national park. [S] (S1, E01)

programme.title: East of Sudan
programme.desc: 1964. Adventure. Directed by Nathan Juran. Stars Anthony Quayle, Sylvia Sims & Derek Fowlds. Two colonial soldiers in 19th-century Africa risk their lives to save a governess and her charge. [S]

programme.title: Star Performance: The Wild Bunch
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Directed by William A. Seiter. Stars Charles Boyer, Gigi Perreau, Natalie Wood. After marrying, a bride reveals to her groom her wealth and family, but he quickly learns they're wild. [S]

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout May. [S]

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Reluctant Widow. 1963. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Christopher Guinee. Meeting at Scotland Yard, Bob helps Cork on a poisoning case of a young woman and a rich man. [S]

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: The Alchemist of Rouen. 1962. Stars Dermot Walsh, Julie Alexander & Trader Faulkner. Richard must investigate when Lady Rosalie informs him that her fiancé has been bewitched by an alchemist. [S]

programme.title: The Young Land
programme.desc: 1959. Western. Director: Ted Tetzlaff. Stars Patrick Wayne, Yvonne Craig & Dennis Hopper. American gunslinger kills a Mexican man. He is arrested and the Hispanic population wait for justice. [S]

programme.title: An Inspector Calls
programme.desc: 1954. Crime. Director: Guy Hamilton. Stars Alastair Sim, Olga Lindo, Eileen Moore. The Birling family are rich and complacent. It is 1912, and the impending war has yet to fall across their lives. [S]

programme.title: The Spaniard's Curse
programme.desc: 1958. Thriller. Director: Ralph Kemplen. Stars Tony Wright, Lee Patterson, Michael Hordern & Susan Beaumont. A man of Spanish heritage is convicted of murder & places a curse on the judge & jury. [S]

programme.title: The Veil
programme.desc: Visions of Crime. 1958. Stars Boris Karloff, Robert Hardy & Jennifer Raine. On a Channel crossing a man foresees his brother's murder. Once the vision proves real he hunts the killer. [S]

programme.title: The Footage Detectives

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's Bat Out of Hell

programme.title: Odd Man Out

programme.title: Body Double
